data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with genuine customer experiences. The company shows quality work in many projects but has consistent patterns of poor warranty follow-through and handling of post-installation issues. Negative reviews are specific and credible, mentioning property damage, staining, and warranty disputes. Positive reviews are detailed and varied, suggesting real satisfied customers. The main concern is the company's responsiveness and accountability when problems arise.
fake_signals: Some reviews mention 'Miller Fence and Patio' while company name is 'Custom Fence & Pergola LLC' - suggests possible name change or confusion
One review mentions blocking negative reviews

negative_evidence: Refusal to honor warranty (Joey Pritchett review)
Illegal warranty terms requiring specific staining every 4 years (Paul Archer review)

authentic_signals: Specific project details (cedar wood, gable, fans, electricity, wooden blinds)
Multiple crew names mentioned (Wes, Daniel, Blake, Todd)
Mix of praise and specific complaints
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Specific timelines and weather conditions mentioned
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google (4.6) and Yelp (4.5). BBB has no rating but no complaints. No major discrepancies.

reviews.text: Miller Fence and Patio did amazing work on our new backyard patio! I had a vision of what I wanted with privacy, a gable, fans, electricity, wooden blinds, ECT. reviews.text: It’s been one year since the construction of our outdoor patio living area with a fireplace. It was put in by Miller Fence and Patio, and I must say it’s the best money I have ever spent. The fire place is such a beautiful work of art and was done by a picture that I gave him and he blew it away. They weren’t the cheapest and weren’t the highest bid out of 6, but it was so worth it.  I’m a hard man to please, but the way Wes communicated during his bid process was what sold me on choosing Miller. I would highly recommend them. They are the company to choose to do the work on your own patio build. You won’t regret it. Mike Kranz

reviews.text: We hired Miller to redo our backyard this summer. We had gotten multiple quotes from fencing companies and their pricing was almost identical to the other companies but we chose Miller because they could also build a pergola and redo our deck flooring as well. They were transparent with pricing and every step of the process and maintained great communication throughout the project. Workers arrived on time and were clean, respectful and polite. At the end of the project there were some issues with the gate motor they installed and they were always happy to come back out and didn't leave until everything was working perfectly. It's been more than a month since they finished and we are extremely happy with our new backyard. I would definitely recommend Miller Fence and Patio!

reviews.text: I have never written a negative review before but I feel compelled to for this company. We hired them to expand our patio for us. The stone from our fire pit immediately began to run off and cause massive staining on our stamped concrete. When I first brought it to Daniel Miller's attention he said the dust from the stone should go away after a couple of weeks. Well months later, after countless attempts to scrub and clean, the concrete is still stained. We asked Daniel what we can do to fix it and his exact response was "Its a natural stone and sometimes they do that.  Nothing can be done about it." When we told him that it was unacceptable to have it look like this and it should be restained if the stains cannot be removed, he told us that it was our fault for choosing these colors and therefore he will no longer respond to our concerns. A LOT of money was spent on this patio, we expected better than this.

Upon digging up the area I found one side of the sprinkler head wedged into the concrete that was poured for the fence post and sprinkler head was removed from the water line. reviews.text:
Warranty void if...
I am not a customer, so I can't speak to the quality of work. But I got a quote from Miller Fence and Patio which included a contract saying that if I didn't have *them* stain the fence every four years, or if I removed their "Miller Fence" sign, it would void the warranty. I told them that the Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act made it clear that the stain requirement (and possibly the sign requirement) was illegal, but I'd be happy to work with them if they'd strike those bits from the contract. Instead, they withdrew their bid.
I would be extremely cautious of any company that had similar terms--especially one that would rather lose a job than change an obviously illegal contract.
